page.about.title: About Us
page.about.groupTitle: Your Trusted Partner in Safety Protection
page.about.groupBody1: Founded in 2002, YourField Group is a national high-tech enterprise and a specialized "Little Giant" company, with more than 500 employees, branches in 25+ major cities, and exports to 32 countries and regions.
page.about.groupBody2: Centered on personal protective equipment, the company has built a "Two Verticals, Two Horizontals" ecosystem covering special PPE, medical devices, safety emergency services, and personal protection services for eight major industries.
page.about.groupBody3: With nearly 60 invention patents and three R&D platforms, YourField has annual capacity for 1.2 million sets of special protective clothing and 15.6 million sets of medical protective clothing.
page.about.groupFact1: ISO13485, ISO9001, and GB/T29490-2013 systems with full traceability
page.about.groupFact2: Strategic cooperation with nearly 120 Fortune Global 500 and state-owned enterprises
page.about.groupFact3: RMB 1 billion investment in a 128-mu, 160,000 m2 protection equipment park
page.about.groupFact4: Founder of the Hunan PPE association, connecting nearly 90 member organizations
page.about.groupCaption: Industrial park, production line, and smart warehousing
page.about.medicalBody1: Hunan YourField Medical Devices Co., Ltd. is a core enterprise of the group, focusing on medical protection for healthcare workers and epidemiology scenarios.
page.about.medicalBody2: The company integrates R&D, production, and sales for medical protective clothing, surgical gowns, cleanroom garments, and related protection solutions, guided by quality, technology, and talent development.
page.about.medicalBody3: Through independent innovation, advanced equipment, intelligent management, and strict quality control, it provides annual capacity for 15.6 million protective suits and 100,000 cubic meters of EO sterilization.
page.about.medicalFact1: R&D and production for protective suits, surgical gowns, and cleanroom garments
page.about.medicalFact2: Doctoral R&D team and collaboration with Donghua University, HUST, and Central South University
page.about.medicalFact3: First company in Hunan licensed to produce medical protective clothing
page.about.medicalFact4: Received eight letters of appreciation for epidemic response support
page.about.medicalCaption: Medical protection manufacturing and quality control
page.about.trainingBody1: Xiangtan YourField Safety Technology Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of YourField Group, providing safety certification training, customized enterprise programs, safety consulting, managed safety services, PPE, and firefighting equipment sales.
page.about.trainingBody2: Approved by the Hunan Emergency Management Department in 2018, the company created Hunan's first industrial-safety-centered VR + experience-based venue with practical training and interactive risk awareness.
page.about.trainingBody3: With a customer-centered service mindset and principles of high standards, advanced technology, and innovation, it is building a benchmark safety culture education platform from Hunan to the national market.
page.about.trainingFact2: Customized programs for enterprises and institutions
page.about.trainingFact3: Safety consulting and managed safety services
page.about.trainingCaption: VR and experience-based safety education scenarios
page.about.sewingTitle: Building a Modern Sewing Talent Brand
page.about.sewingBody1: The "Liancheng YourField Sewing Masters" labor brand was launched in 2022 by Hunan YourField Special Protective Equipment Co., Ltd., a specialized "Little Giant" enterprise, with support from Xiangtan authorities.
page.about.sewingBody2: Rooted in Liancheng culture and more than 20 years of protective clothing manufacturing, the brand has systematically cultivated new-era sewing artisans since 2023 under the idea of craftsmanship and intelligent manufacturing.
page.about.sewingBody3: Through a training-employment-growth system, intelligent hanging systems, digital sewing practice, and university-industry training bases, it supports high-quality manufacturing talent for Xiangtan and the region.
page.about.sewingFact1: Combines Liancheng culture with protective clothing craftsmanship
page.about.sewingFact2: Addresses skills gaps and structural employment needs in apparel manufacturing
page.about.sewingFact3: Smart hanging systems and digital sewing equipment practice
page.about.sewingFact4: Training bases with Hunan Institute of Engineering, Hunan University of Science and Technology, and partners
page.about.sewingCaption: Modern sewing talent training and craftsmanship practice
page.about.cultureText: YourField connects technology-enabled protection, brand responsibility, talent development, and long-term innovation so every product, process, and service supports safer work.

page.about.cultureVideoText: Manufacturing responsibility, team spirit, and the safety protection mission come together in one story.

page.compliance.privacy.section3Text: To request access, correction, deletion, or withdrawal for submitted information, use the contact page. The final rights notice is subject to the legal-approved version.
page.compliance.cookies.title: Cookie Usage Notice
page.compliance.cookies.intro: Learn how this website uses a necessary language-preference cookie and how you can manage it.
page.compliance.cookies.summaryTitle: We only save a necessary language-preference cookie
page.compliance.cookies.summaryText: We value your browsing experience and privacy. This website currently uses only a necessary language-preference cookie to remember your selected language version, so the right content can open on your next visit.
page.compliance.cookies.section1Text: When you switch language on the website, we save a language-preference cookie to record the version you selected, such as 中文, English, or Русский. This helps the site show your previously selected language first on future visits.
page.compliance.cookies.section2Title: What this cookie is used for
page.compliance.cookies.section2Text: The language-preference cookie is used only to remember your language choice, reduce repeated language switching, and help the website display the matching language version.
page.compliance.cookies.section3Title: What we do not use cookies for
page.compliance.cookies.section3Text: This website currently does not use advertising cookies, marketing cookies, or third-party tracking cookies. We do not use cookies for user profiling, cross-site tracking, or third-party marketing analysis.
page.compliance.cookies.section4Text: You can view, block, or clear cookies at any time through your browser settings. After clearing cookies, the website may return to its default language, and you can still choose your preferred language again.
page.compliance.cookies.contactText: If the website adds visit analytics, advertising analysis, or other third-party tools in the future, we will update this notice before enabling them and provide consent management options where required. If you have questions about how this website uses cookies, please contact us.
page.compliance.terms.title: Terms of Service and Legal Notice
page.compliance.terms.intro: Explains website content, inquiry submission, and use boundaries; final legal wording still requires legal approval.
page.compliance.terms.summaryText: The final version should cover site use rules, intellectual property, product information limits, liability boundaries, and governing law.
page.compliance.terms.section1Text: Visitors may browse public content and submit genuine business inquiries. They must not abuse forms, submit unlawful content, or disrupt website operation.
page.compliance.terms.section2Text: Product parameters, certifications, images, and downloadable materials are provided for business introduction. Procurement, certification, and contractual obligations are subject to mutually confirmed documents.
page.compliance.terms.section3Text: Liability limits, dispute handling, governing law, and update notices must be approved by legal counsel. Please contact us before the final terms are published.
